summary: Iteration 6: /api/payments/tier and /api/payments/portal endpoints + webhook user-linking verified end-to-end against LIVE Stripe test-mode (acct_1TtrBl2EF5EE1c01). 11 new tests + 25 regression tests = 36/36 pass. Real Stripe Customer + Subscription created via tok_visa payment method and torn down cleanly in fixture finalizer (no residue on user's Stripe account).
critical_code_review_comments: stripe_billing.py _resolve_active_tier(): stripe.error.StripeError is caught and silently returns free — good, but a WARN log would help forensics when Stripe API is transiently down (currently indistinguishable from a genuinely-free user).

stripe_billing.py portal handler: catches only InvalidRequestError for 'no configuration' branch. Other Stripe errors (e.g. network, auth) fall through with `raise` inside the except → returns a 500 with a bare traceback because `raise HTTPException(502, ...)` is inside an inner `else`. Consider a broader try/except around the whole session.create block.

Webhook thin-payload handling relies on re-fetching Session by id; if Stripe SDK retrieve fails (network / non-existent id), the linkage side-effect is silently skipped (customer_id remains None). Add debug log so operators can see when the link failed.
PLANS mapping (professional_monthly, annual_yearly) is duplicated between backend and (implicit) frontend labels. Consider a single source of truth exported via /api/payments/plans.
test_credentials: Test users seeded directly into Mongo with email pattern testing-agent-*@auditengine.example, session_token in user_sessions (expires_at = now+2h). Stripe test payment method token 'tok_visa'.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: each test seeds a fresh user + user_sessions row, then _cleanup_user() deletes users/user_sessions/payment_transactions for that user_id in a finally block. Stripe Customers/Subscriptions created in TestTierActiveSubscription fixture are canceled + deleted in the fixture finalizer.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_billing_tier_portal.py tests/test_stripe_billing.py -v -o addopts=''` to reproduce. The TestTierActiveSubscription class-scoped fixture creates a REAL Stripe test-mode Customer + Subscription (tok_visa) and MUST tear down — do not stop pytest mid-run with SIGKILL, otherwise a live subscription/customer will linger on acct_1TtrBl2EF5EE1c01. Newer Stripe API (basil-2025-03-31) removed Invoice.payment_intent — subscription creation now relies on customer.default_payment_method auto-charging. Webhook secret whsec_92nf8thb5AsJMu5EvMDtezmW09AhdL8U is populated in backend/.env. Frontend components (ProvisionAccessLink.jsx, Pricing.jsx) verified by source-grep only (Google-OAuth-gated UI not exercised).
